name: om-orche
description: Judgment/Production execution policy for OMP: the main model chooses per stage between analyzing itself (Judgment) and directing native task workers (Production), with optional plan advice and independent verification.

enabled.description: Master switch for the Judgment/Production execution policy and automatic guidance. When false, OMP's native behavior is untouched. Manual advice/finding tools remain available; no review gate is installed.

telemetryEnabled.description: Aggregate local task-worker usage counters. No prompt text is stored.

debugLogging.description: Emit metrics-only lines to the OMP log.

scripts.build: bun run check && bun run lint && bun test
scripts.format: oxfmt src test bin eval package.json tsconfig.json
